# SS Indo Solar: full reference

## Who we are
SS Indo Solar is a Kanpur-based solar EPC (engineering, procurement and construction) company: installation and services. We are not a retailer or wholesaler. Owner: Saadullah Khan (M.Tech, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation and Control, Aligarh Muslim University; certified Rooftop Solar PV Entrepreneur under Skill India, NSQF Level 6; co-patentee of Indian Patent 429440, a solar PV based charging station for electric vehicles, granted 20-04-2023).
Approvals: UPNEDA empanelled vendor for PM Surya Ghar / Grid Connected Solar Rooftop Programme Phase-II in Uttar Pradesh (approved 10-06-2025). Ex-Waaree authorised franchise; F-Class customer of Waaree Energies Limited.

## Where we work
Key operating regions: Uttar Pradesh and Delhi NCR. Head office and warehouse: Kanpur. Branches: Kaimganj (District Farrukhabad), Farrukhabad, Aligarh.
Address: MIG 86, K.D.A. Colony, Jajmau, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh 208010. Phone: +91 7906786485, +91 9451875234. Email: ssindosolargroup@gmail.com, ssindosolar@waareepartners.com.

## Services
EPC: client meeting, designing, installation and commissioning under one contract.
System design: layout/blueprint and site survey. The survey covers roof type, slab thickness, obstacles, cable shaft, anchoring permission, pillars and beams, power factor, vacant breaker, bus bar, transformer details, DG sets and RPR. Customers share: existing electrical scheme, layout/plot plan, last 6 months of electricity bills, connected load, structural approval for roof strength, room layout for inverter/LT panel, earth resistivity report, building elevation drawing.
Liasoning: project registration at the State Nodal Agency, Discom application, approvals, net metering, net billing/feeding or gross metering as per state policy.
AMC: annual maintenance contract: monitoring, routine and breakdown maintenance, warranty coordination, plant insurance support.
MCS: module cleaning system: mechanized cleaning and water harvesting arrangement.
Also: grid-tied, off-grid and hybrid systems, solar water heaters (Waaree), solar pumps (PM-KUSUM), commercial and industrial plants (25 kW to 110 kW string inverters).
Finance: MSME, NBFC, SIDBI and bank assistance; 80% accelerated depreciation on commercial rooftop systems.

## Projects
Darul Uloom Deoband 300 kW on-grid; Vidyagyan School Sitapur 300 kW; AKI Magarwara, Unnao 50 kW on-grid; DTS Madarsa, Jajmau 25 kW on-grid; Govt. High School Mambakkam, Chennai (off-grid); 5 HP solar water pump, Chaudagra, Fatehpur.

## Green goal
Reduce CO2 emissions with rooftop solar. Estimate used on the site: about 1,400 kWh per kW per year in Uttar Pradesh and a grid emission factor of 0.727 tCO2/MWh (CEA CO2 Baseline Database v20, FY 2023-24).

## How to get a quote
Message the monthly electricity bill on WhatsApp (+91 7906786485). We recommend a system size and share a quote. We do not publish prices.
